note: Methodological scenario settings, not estimates from empirical TBI geography. Area inference is primary. Population-weighted inference is secondary with linear primary nuisance model plus prospectively frozen cubic sensitivity.
population_conditioning_primary_model: linear: intercept + z(log1p(mapped adult population age 18+))
population_conditioning_sensitivity_mode: cubic fixed-design polynomial: intercept + z + centered(z^2) + centered(z^3), z=z(log1p(mapped adult population age 18+))
population_nuisance_disagreement_rule: If linear and cubic conditional p-values cross alpha in different directions, label population-weighted inference nuisance-model-dependent; do not choose the favorable specification.
msr_primary_algorithm: Wagner-Dray singleton MSR on the continuous surface (independent sign randomization of MEM coefficients)
msr_pair_sensitivity_role: pre-execution algorithmic robustness audit only; not a second application p-value unless explicitly reported in supplement
